description.text: The second HeartGold & SoulSilver set, released on 12 May 2010 with 96 cards: 95 and a secret Alph Lithograph. It brought in the first LEGEND cards with two Pokémon, pairing Entei, Raikou and Suicune as Entei & Raikou, Raikou & Suicune and Suicune & Entei, and six Pokémon Prime, among them Tyranitar and Steelix, who lead its theme decks, Chaos Control and Steel Sentinel. Its cards came from several Japanese releases: the HeartGold and SoulSilver Collections, Revived Legends and decks.
